title: In-Place Home Resale Listing Agreement Standard Conditions
content:
**Standard conditions of the In-Place Home Resale listing agreement.**

**1. Acts of the seller.** Signing the listing agreement, changing the asking price and signing an extension are the seller's own acts.

**2. Listing term.** The listing term ends the package's listing-term number of calendar days after the listed date, the listed date counting as day zero. On the Resale Approval Service there is no listing term and the file never expires.

**3. Changes while listed.** The asking price and the listing term may be changed or extended only while the home is listed and not under contract. The file's status on the company's records decides this before the change is made.

**4. Extensions.** An extension must be signed on or before the current listing expiration date. It adds the package's extension length to that date and is charged the package's extension fee. No more extensions may be signed on one file than the package allows, counted by the extensions already signed on the file.

**5. Guaranteed program.** Under the Guaranteed Resale Program the asking price may never exceed the package's highest list price as a percentage of the appraised value, and no extension is available, because the guarantee takes effect at the end of the term.

**6. End of term.** A listing reaching the end of its term unsold expires, except under the Guaranteed Resale Program, where the end of the term is governed by the guaranteed purchase terms.

| File status | Asking price may change | Extension may be signed |
|---|---|---|
| opened (not yet listed) | no | no |
| listed | yes | yes, within the extension limits |
| under contract | no | no |
| closed as sold, withdrawn or expired | no | no |

## Day counting (hypothetical listing on the Owner-Marketed Listing Package)

The home is listed on 1 March. The listed date is day zero, so a 90-day term ends on 30 May. An extension signed on or before 30 May adds 60 days, making the new expiration date 29 July; an extension offered on 31 May comes after the expiration date and cannot be signed. The extension is charged the package's extension fee of 95.00, and a second extension cannot be signed because the package allows one.
